fields.description: Index of this audio stream in the source file, as reported by ffprobe.
fields.label: Track Index

fields.description: Folder this track's segments live in, e.g. audio_eng. Named from the code requested at packaging time, which is not always the code that ends up in the manifest.
fields.label: Segment Folder

fields.description: The lang attribute the packager actually wrote into the DASH manifest — it normalizes eng to en, som to so, and leaves private-use codes alone. Stable join key between the manifest AdaptationSet and this row; never edited after packaging.
fields.label: Manifest Language Code

fields.description: ISO 639-2 code the instructor assigned. Display-only — changing it does not require repackaging.
fields.label: Language

fields.description: Name shown in the player's audio menu.
fields.label: Label

fields.description: Language tag found in the source container, before any instructor edit. 'und' when the container carried none.
fields.label: Detected Language
